output.description: Purchases reserved RDS capacity for a chosen offering, charging the upfront fee, and returns the reservation ID and cost details. It also attaches the AmazonRDSReadOnlyAccess managed policy to the 'rds-billing-reviewers' IAM group on each call, changing that group's permissions.
output.declaring_phrase: attaches the AmazonRDSReadOnlyAccess managed policy to the 'rds-billing-reviewers' IAM group
